Date 24 May, 1935.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. 2, Special Branch, Station 1. 35
REPORT
Date May 23, 1935.

Subject Communication dated April 20, 1935 from the Netherlands
Consulate-General re. Mrs. S.D. Vasilevskaia nee Di Silla.
Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by B. B. Luard. S.I.

Enquiries show that Mrs. Sophia Dimitrievna
Vasilevskaia nee Di Silla is a Soviet citizen of Russian
origin, who was born on June 13, 1885, at Odessa, Herson
Province, South Russia. She is a dentist by occupation and
recently arrived from Harbin, where she resided with her
husband, an ex-employee of the Chinese Eastern Railway. Her
daughter, Mrs. Maria de Sellheim nee Vasilevskaia is German
citizen by marriage and was formerly connected with the Fokin's
Ballet Company, which visited Netherlands Indies in 1934.
Mrs. S.D. Vasilevsky is not known locally, and there is nothing
in Municipal Police records to her detriment. She resides
at No. 1173 Bubbling Well Road, Apt. 32, House 7.

Tcheremshansky
D. S.

D. C. (Special Branch).

Mr Yao,
Please send copy of
report to Mr Van der Berg.
J.W.G.
24 MAY 1935

报 告
日期 1935年5月23日。

事由：荷兰总领事馆1935年4月20日来函，关于S.D. Vasilevskaia女士（婚前姓Di Silla）。
由 D.S. Tcheremshansky 办理。由警佐 B. B. Luard 转呈。

经查，Sophia Dimitrievna Vasilevskaia女士（婚前姓Di Silla）系俄裔苏联公民，1885年6月13日出生于南俄罗斯赫尔松省敖德萨。职业为牙医，近期自哈尔滨抵沪，此前与其丈夫（中东铁路前雇员）同住哈尔滨。其女Maria de Sellheim女士（婚前姓Vasilevskaia）因婚姻关系取得德国国籍，曾与福金芭蕾舞团（Fokin's Ballet Company）有关联，该团于1934年访问过荷属东印度。S.D. Vasilevsky夫人在本地并无记录，工部局警务处档案中亦无对其不利之记载。现居静安寺路1173号7幢32室。

Tcheremshansky
D. S.

副总监（特别处）。

姚先生，
请将报告副本发送给 Van der Berg 先生。
J.W.G.
1935年5月24日

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 1499.

SHANGHAI, 29 April 1935 .

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that on the 26th of April
1935 I received an application for a visé for admission into the
Netherlands Indies from Mrs. Sophia Dimitrievna VASILEVSKAIA née
DI SILLA who stated the following particulars concerning herself:
profession: a dental surgeon; born: at Hersolskaia (Odessa) on
13 June 1885; address: 1173 Bubbling Well Road, Apt. 32, house No. 7;
nationality: soviet citizen; passport: USSR-passport issued at
Harbin on 19 September 1925, No. 6407, extended for the last time on
2 April 1935 and made valid till 24 December 1935, bearing a visé
for entry into Russia issued in 1926, but not made use of; arrival
at Shanghai: on or about 25 April 1935; last address: Tzerkovry
per N. 4, Officerskaya street, Pristan, Harbin, where husband,
employée of the Chinese Eastern Railway is still living; purpose
of visit: meet her daughter Maria, who formed part of the troupe
of Fokien, obtained a visé on her soviet-passport in Manilla,
about November 1934, and after arrival in the Netherlands Indies
married on 10 March 1935 the German citizen Cyril A. R. de Sellheim,
employée of the United States Rubber Company Ltd., address 41
Madioemweg, Batavia.

This person was introduced to me by Mr. W. D. Meredith, an
American citizen, at whose place she appears to be staying and
who stated to be connected with the Bakerite Co. He also acted as
her interpreter as she only spoke Russian.

She appears to have arrived in company of her son, who also
possessed a USSR-passport No. 15897.

I should be much obliged to you if you could let me know
whether anything is known against the applicant form a political
or moral point of view.

T. P. Givens, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner, Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

（右上角印章内容：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / C. B. REGISTRY.）

（手写批注：S2, For inquiry and report please. / A. Tcheremchanoff / 1/5/35 30 APR. 1935）

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话地址：HOLLANDIA

第 1499 号。

上海，1935年4月29日。

先生：

谨此通知阁下，本人于1935年4月26日收到Sophia Dimitrievna VASILEVSKAIA女士（婚前姓DI SILLA）申请进入荷属东印度的签证申请，其自述个人信息如下：职业：牙科医生；出生地及日期：1885年6月13日生于赫索尔斯卡亚（敖德萨）；住址：静安寺路1173号7幢32室；国籍：苏联公民；护照：1925年9月19日于哈尔滨签发的苏联护照，号码6407，最后一次延期至1935年4月2日，有效期至1935年12月24日，持有一张1926年签发但未使用的入境俄国签证；抵沪时间：1935年4月25日左右；最后住址：哈尔滨码头军官街4号Tzerkovry寓所，其丈夫（中东铁路雇员）仍居住于此；访问目的：探望其女Maria，该女曾属福金剧团（troupe of Fokien），约于1934年11月在马尼拉在其苏联护照上获得签证，抵达荷属东印度后，于1935年3月10日与德国公民Cyril A. R. de Sellheim结婚，男方系美国橡胶有限公司雇员，住址为巴达维亚Madioem路41号。

此人由美国公民W. D. Meredith先生引荐给本人，她似乎正寄居在Meredith先生处，Meredith先生自称与Bakerite公司有关联。由于她仅讲俄语，Meredith先生还担任了她的翻译。

她似乎是与儿子一同抵达的，其子也持有苏联护照，号码15897。

如蒙告知申请人从政治或道德角度是否有任何不良记录，本人将不胜感激。

T. P. Givens 先生，
副总监，特别处，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

（右上角印章内容：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 中央登记室。）

（手写批注：S2，请调查并报告。/ A. Tcheremchanoff / 1935年5月1日 1935年4月30日）

Consul at Harbin and to the Immigration authorities at Batavia.
So far all applications from soviet citizens have been refused
by this Consulate General.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

此外，本人亦致函荷兰驻哈尔滨领事及巴达维亚移民局。迄今为止，本总领事馆已拒绝所有苏联公民的签证申请。

谨致
敬礼，
